name: Bottle Blast VR - Bottle Shooting Game
summary:
Bottle Blast VR – Bottle Shooting Game brings a classic shooting challenge into virtual reality with a puzzle-style twist. Your goal is simple: break all the bottles—but with a limited number of bullets, every shot must be planned carefully.
